In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.   3. Identify reasoning gaps, tool-use failures, or logic errors in AI assistant responses, providing actionable feedback for iterative improvement.
  4. Produce clear, concise written feedback on both strengths and areas for improvement, directly influencing model refinement and AI adoption practices.

  6. Maintain meticulous documentation of evaluations and recommendations, ensuring transparency and traceability in assessment workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  2. Advanced, daily use of AI assistants (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) as an essential work and productivity tool.
  3. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and communicate findings effectively in writing.
  4. Background in process improvement, rubric development, or operational quality assessment in an enterprise or educational context.
  5. Strong critical thinking skills with a focus on consistency, integrity, and fairness in evaluations.
  6. Comfort working independently on large volumes of similar examples while maintaining high attention to detail.

Flowmingo is a Y Combinator-backed startup (plus VinaCapital & top global investors) on a mission to democratize hiring. We believe the current hiring model is broken: recruiters only have time to interview 5% of applicants, leaving 95% of talent—the "hidden gems"—undiscovered. We are fixing this with an AI-native, high-volume interviewing platform. Our model is unique: we offer our tool for free to recruiters to capture the massive, uncontested markets of Southeast Asia, LATAM, and Africa. This allows us to process massive volumes of candidates that traditional, expensive platforms cannot touch.

About the Role

As a Marketing Growth Business Partner, you will help amplify Flowmingo through content, community, and thought leadership. You will spark conversations, educate audiences about modern hiring, and guide interested teams toward adopting the platform.

This is a referral-based role with no fixed hours. Whether you're an agency recruiter, HR consultant, talent acquisition expert, or simply someone with strong ties in the hiring space, this role offers flexibility and high-impact potential.

  • Introduce Flowmingo to your network and community.

  • Share how our AI interview platform transforms hiring and saves time.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact and thought partner as users explore the platform.

  • Provide real-time market feedback to help improve our product and programs.

  • Operate independently and earn based on your results.

Who This Is For

  • Content creators & community builders

  • HR influencers and marketing professionals

  • People with audiences in business, HR, or recruitment

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills

  • Self-driven, creative, and growth-oriented mindset

Compensation & Benefits

  • Work Anytime, Anywhere: This is a commission-only partner role, meaning you set your own hours and work from any location.

  • High-Reward Potential: Your earnings are based on the successful referrals you generate, with a transparent payout structure. Commission increases with volume and consistency.

How to Join

Please fill out the form on the right. If you're a good fit, we will inform you regarding the next steps within 1-3 working days (Please make sure to check your spam box).

Before applying, take a few minutes to browse Flowmingo’s website so you can understand our product and value.

If you’re excited to represent a product that sells itself—and want a flexible role with high earnings potential—join us in shaping the future of hiring.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

raw.description:
Why you should join us

Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

The opportunity is massive — car insurance alone is a $300B market in the U.S. We spent the last few years building our supply (we work with 100+ insurance carriers) and our technical infrastructure (60% of policies today are sold automatically without human intervention, 90% of inbound customer inquiries are resolved via AI and automation). The next chapter is about accelerating our growth — going from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

About this role

The Growth team owns the entire customer sign-up and purchase funnel for our car insurance marketplace, and drives how millions of people discover, evaluate, and become a Jerry customer.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the customer journey from first impression through purchase and beyond. This role sits at the heart of our business - you’ll take end-to-end ownership of high-impact funnels that directly move the needle on our north star goal. This is not a “growth hacking” role or one that prioritizes revenue at the cost of the customer experience and trust — we care about building a durable growth engine by creating a magical customer experience and providing unreasonable hospitality. You will need to investigate and understand customer needs across different personas, navigate complex backend systems, and translate that complexity into clear, trustworthy, and elegant user experiences.

This role reports to the VP of Growth. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, and Leadership — including the CEO — to identify step-change opportunities and turn insight into shipped products that meaningfully moves the business.

What you will actually do

Things move quickly here and we just launched 5 big products this year, so there likely won’t be a “typical” day but here are some examples of things you could own:

  • Own landing pages, signup funnels, app download pages, including simplifying the user flow (insurance shopping is very complex and requires a lot of data inputs from the customer), personalizing the experience by user persona and marketing channel, building trust through designing delightful and helpful communication, copy and UI, etc

  • Own quote shopping, including improving the display of complex information to our customers without cognitive overload, integrating different insurance carriers (who all model risk and behave differently) into simple user experiences, balancing the needs and goals of our customers and our insurance carrier partners

  • Integrating other products (e.g., roadside assistance, home insurance, property tax appeals, motorcycle insurance, etc) into our car insurance shopping funnel

Why you will (or won't) like it here

  • Direct exposure: You'll report directly to our VP of Growth with visibility to the c-suite team. You'll have visibility into product strategy, business model tradeoffs, and roadmap decisions from Day One.

  • Time zone constraint: The engineering team is partly based overseas. Occasionally, you may need to overlap with their business hours.

  • Small team: The Growth team has 3 Product Managers (including you) and the surface area is huge, which means you'll have to be scrappy, but also that you'll have lots of scope and ownership.

  • Fast shipping culture: We run weekly sprints. Products that take 6-12 months to ship elsewhere, we launch in 1-2 months. This means faster learning and faster growth, but also a more demanding environment.

Who we get excited about

  • First principles thinker: You’re comfortable breaking ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before reaching for a solution, as well as working with incomplete information.

  • Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Customer-centric: You find customer feedback intrinsically interesting and not some box to check. You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

  • Strong communicator: You can work effectively across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing, including across time zones. You calibrate how much context others need and give it clearly.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product management (ideally consumer-facing products)

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize messy signals into clear recommendations

  • Willingness to maintain regular daily overlap with global business hours for engineering coordination

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $160K - $210K

Fully Remote (International) | Full-Time Contractor | Paid in USD$7.25 – $10.25 USD/hour, based on experience and demonstrated results

Can you launch a lead-generation campaign, read the data, and know exactly what to fix? Do you understand why an ad underperforms — and what to test next? If paid advertising is your craft, keep reading.

We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll own paid ad campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for 8–12 client accounts — driving real leads for real businesses, with your results visible every single week.

This is a performance-driven role. Vanity metrics don't matter here. CPL, ROAS, and conversion rates do.

Campaign Management

  • Launch, monitor, and scale campaigns across Facebook and Instagram

  • Own 8–12 client ad accounts simultaneously

  • Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, headlines, and offers

Creative & Copy

  • Write direct-response ad copy in English for lead generation campaigns

  • Contribute to creative strategy and funnel optimization

Reporting & Communication

  • Track and report on the KPIs that matter: CPL, CTR, ROAS, and conversion rates

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running Facebook/Meta Ads, ideally for U.S. or English-speaking markets

  • Deep understanding of lead generation and direct-response advertising

  • Proven experience managing multiple client accounts at once

  • Ability to read ad metrics and make data-driven optimization calls

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Creative Project Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for crafting great campaigns, videos, and visual stories. You’ll oversee the smooth and timely execution of event and activation ideas, the production of bold and high-impact creative work, and community growth.

What You’ll Do

1. Project & Workflow Management

  • Manage creative project intake, ensuring requests are clearly briefed, prioritized, and aligned with business needs

  • Oversee the entire creative workflow — from kickoff to delivery — keeping all moving parts on track

  • Maintain visibility of timelines, resources, and dependencies to prevent bottlenecks and ensure deadlines are met

2. Resource & Asset Coordination

  • Allocate and manage resources across multiple creative projects

  • Ensure designers, videographers, and content creators have all required briefs, references, and materials before starting

  • Maintain organized creative asset libraries and ensure proper version control

3. Cross-Team Communication

  • Serve as the central liaison between creative, marketing, product, and leadership teams

  • Communicate project updates, timelines, and priorities clearly and consistently

  • Ensure alignment and transparency across all creative initiatives

4. Process Improvement & Quality Control

  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to optimize speed and quality

  • Uphold creative quality by ensuring all projects go through proper review and approval processes

  • Support post-project reviews to evaluate success and gather learnings for future initiatives

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Project Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 3–5 years in project management, traffic management, or creative operations (agency or in-house).

  • Proven ability to manage complex, fast-moving creative projects end-to-end.

  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving mindset.

  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, Notion) and familiarity with creative tools/workflows.

  • Bonus: Experience managing video production or digital campaigns.

Location

This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malaysia office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Online assessment or practical task

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final Interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

Small businesses are the backbone of our communities — yet they remain underserved by traditional banks and legacy payment providers. As a Principal Backend Engineer, you will play a defining role in changing that.

Your mission is to design and build the resilient, scalable fintech infrastructure that underpins our most critical business initiatives. This isn’t about owning a single service — it’s about owning outcomes. You will drive the technical success of the platforms that power payments, merchant onboarding, transaction processing, and operational workflows across Europe.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering and business strategy, shaping systems that must be secure, compliant, highly available, and capable of scaling with rapid growth. The decisions you make will directly influence how quickly we can launch new products, enter new markets, and serve thousands of merchants.

This role goes beyond technical leadership. You will define and evolve the architectural foundations that multiple teams depend on, bringing clarity to ambiguity and ensuring our most important initiatives succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive the architecture behind our most critical platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and unlock new capabilities

  • Design and evolve high-scale, cloud-native systems powering payments and merchant experiences

  • Lead the development of resilient, secure, and compliant services for high-volume transaction processing

  • Shape and drive adoption of modern backend practices (Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3, Kotlin, clean architecture)

  • Architect event-driven systems (Kafka) that enable scalable, decoupled domains across teams

  • Define and enforce standards for API-first development (REST/gRPC) and domain-driven design (DDD)

  • Set the bar for availability, performance, fault tolerance, and observability across critical systems

  • Partner deeply with Product, Data, and leadership to translate business priorities into scalable technical strategy

  • Lead cross-organisational initiatives that are essential to company growth and market expansion

  • Influence engineering direction through hands-on contribution, design leadership, and mentorship

  • Bring structure to ambiguity across technical, regulatory, and operational domains

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience building and operating distributed, production-grade backend systems

  • Proven track record operating at Senior Staff or Principal level, driving architecture across multiple teams or domains

  • Deep expertise in Java (17+), Spring Boot, and modern backend engineering practices

  • Strong experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous systems

  • Experience building systems for high throughput, low latency, and reliability, ideally in fintech or transaction-heavy environments

  • Strong grounding in system design, data structures, and performance trade-offs

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes in production environments

  • Proven ability to implement observability, resilience patterns, and CI/CD best practices

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and align stakeholders

  • A track record of mentoring senior engineers and leading through ambiguity

The Perks

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long it suits both you and your team;

  • Health Insurance;

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with MyFitness;

  • 25 days of Annual leave (+ Bank Holidays);

  • Possibility to visit other Teya offices to meet colleagues in instances when travel is safe and appropriate;

  • Friday lunch in the office;

  • Friendly, comfortable and high-end work equipment and informal office environment;

  • Hybrid work mode policy.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client builds the data layer that AI agents actually run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data — the boring-hard problem every team building with AI eventually slams into, solved for good.

They hit eight figures in ARR in year one, then more than doubled it. 150,000+ GitHub stars and climbing, driven entirely by word of mouth — no paid acquisition, no growth hacks. Over 1.25 million developers and 150,000+ companies build on this platform today. They just closed a Series A led by a top-tier VC firm, with their existing accelerator and a well-known tech CEO angel investor also in the round.

The team is roughly 35 to 39 people. Small on purpose. Hybrid in San Francisco, working shoulder to shoulder with the founder.

The Mission

Every AI lab, every agent, every model needs clean web data, and that demand isn't slowing down. This team is building the infrastructure that superintelligence will lean on to read and act on the web. You'd be getting in while the category is still being drawn, on a problem that gets more central to AI every single month.

The Opportunity

As a Product Engineer, you'll build the thing developers reach for when they need to turn the messy, hostile, constantly-shifting web into clean data and reliable actions an AI can take. This is real product engineering on the company's browser-automation and agent-interaction surface. You ship it, you own it, and it's in front of thousands of developers within days.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship developer-facing features from idea to production, not backlog tickets, actual shipped product

  • Own the reliability of what you ship against a web that changes constantly and fights back

  • Turn genuinely hard, ambiguous problems into clean APIs developers love using

  • Sit directly with the engineering team on roadmap calls and the tradeoffs behind them

  • Dogfood your own product, read the GitHub issues, and let real developer pain, decide what you build next

What You Bring

  • 3–8 years of experience in product engineering, shipping browser automation, web scraping, or AI agent tooling to external developers (not internal tools, not consumer-facing apps)

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js (required), with hands-on depth in Playwright, Puppeteer, browser-use, Stagehand, or Chromium internals

  • A track record of owning features end-to-end with no PM and no designer, ideally at a sub-200-person startup (Series A through C)

  • Demonstrated obsession with developer experience — you treat API latency, response format, error messages, and docs as first-class design concerns, not afterthoughts

  • A bias toward shipping in days, not weeks, with comfort making calls on imperfect data and killing features that don't work

  • Able to work hybrid from the San Francisco Bay Area

Bonus points if you've got:

  • Founding engineer, MTS, or infrastructure engineer experience at a DevTools or AI-agent startup

  • Repeat founder or founder-CEO background with a real shipped product and GitHub traction

  • Hands-on understanding of how AI agents select and use tools, and what makes prompt-based browser interaction reliable versus fragile

Key Success Drivers

This is a seat for high-agency builders — people who want to own something end-to-end without layers, committees, or waiting for someone's permission to ship. The single trait that matters most here: you care, personally, about how the product feels to use. Not "it works," it feels right. You read the GitHub issues yourself, and instinctively argue for the developer on the other end of the API, even when nobody's asking you to.

Why Join?

Compensation & Equity

  • Base salary $235,000–$260,000

  • Competitive equity, with details shared during the process

Benefits

  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for employees, 50% for spouse/kids)

  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • 12 weeks fully paid parental leave

  • $1,000/year learning and development stipend

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Generous PTO plus a 3-month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Pet insurance — Because fur babies are family too

  • Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

  • A loaner electric bike to get you around the city

Location

  • Hybrid from the San Francisco Bay Area office, with regular team offsites

Visa Sponsorship Details

  • Open to visa transfers (e.g., OPT, H-1B transfers)

Interviewing Process

  1. Intro Chat (25 minutes)

  2. Technical Chat (50 minutes)

  3. Founders Chat

  4. Paid Work Trial (1 to 2 weeks, approximately 40 hours) — Non-negotiable, paid at your full-time rate.

  5. Offer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $235K - $260K

raw.title: Storyous Product Designer (UX/UI)
raw.excerpt: Storyous je pokladní systém pro gastro podniky, který funguje samostatně v rámci fintech skupiny Teya, k níž jsme se připojili v roce 2021.
raw.description:
Storyous je pokladní systém pro gastro podniky, který funguje samostatně v rámci fintech skupiny Teya, k níž jsme se připojili v roce 2021.

Naše portfolio stojí na robustním pokladním systému, pokročilé datové analytice a dalších modulech, které ve spojení s integracemi a vlastním platebním řešením Teya tvoří komplexní all-in-one řešení pro jednotlivé podniky i řetězce s desítkami poboček.

Hledáme Product Designera/ku, který/á bude designovým partnerem pro Product a Engineering a převezme odpovědnost za UX/UI napříč celým produktem. Budeš převádět produktová zadání a vlastní nápady do promyšlených návrhů a prototypů, hledat příležitosti ke zjednodušení uživatelských cest a podílet se na tom, jak bude Storyous fungovat v praxi.

Jedná se o nově vytvořenou roli s velkou mírou autonomie. Máme existující design language a designové podklady ve Figmě, ale současně plánujeme větší redesign tabletové aplikace a chceme náš design dále sjednocovat a rozvíjet.

Co tě v roli čeká

  • Budeš navrhovat UX/UI napříč tabletovou aplikací, webovým Adminem, mobilní aplikací, Kioskem a Premium Analytics.

  • Zapojíš se do přípravy a realizace většího redesignu tabletové aplikace.

  • Budeš převádět produktová zadání, zákaznické potřeby a vlastní návrhy do user flow, wireframů, interaktivních prototypů a finálních návrhů ve Figmě.

  • Budeš aktivně hledat místa, kde lze produkt nebo uživatelskou cestu zjednodušit a zlepšit.

  • Vyrazíš do terénu za našimi zákazníky, povedeš user interviews, budeš pozorovat používání produktu v reálném provozu a využiješ zjištění pro další návrhy.

  • Budeš rozvíjet naše design language, komponenty a šablony a dbát na konzistenci napříč platformami.

  • Budeš úzce spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem od prvního nápadu až po implementaci.

  • Budeš řešit designová dilemata, připravovat návrhy včetně potřebných stavů a edge cases a dokumentovat designová rozhodnutí ve Figmě, Jira a Confluence.

  • Budeš využívat AI nástroje, například Claude, pro zrychlení rutinní práce, iteraci návrhů a tvorbu klikacích prototypů.

Koho hledáme

Tahle role je vhodná pro člověka, který už má zkušenost s designem digitálních produktů a chce převzít širší ownership. Nehledáme pouze někoho, kdo umí vytvořit kvalitní obrazovku. Potřebujeme designera, který rozumí problému, umí pracovat s uživatelem, dokáže návrh obhájit a dotáhnout ho ve spolupráci s týmem.

Hodit se k nám budeš, pokud:

  • máš alespoň 3 roky zkušeností s designem digitálních produktů a portfolio s projekty, které se skutečně dostaly do používání;

  • dobře ovládáš Figmu včetně komponent, variant, prototypování a sdílených knihoven;

  • máš zkušenost s touch rozhraním i komplexními webovými aplikacemi;

  • umíš převést nejasné zadání do srozumitelného flow a implementovatelného designu;

  • máš praktickou zkušenost s user interviews, usability testingem nebo pozorováním uživatelů v terénu;

  • dokážeš pracovat samostatně, nastavovat si priority a přicházet s vlastními návrhy na zlepšení;

  • umíš spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem a přijímat i poskytovat věcnou zpětnou vazbu;

  • používáš AI nástroje prakticky a s dobrým úsudkem;

  • domluvíš se plynně česky nebo slovensky a angličtina pro tebe není problém v každodenní práci.

✔ Zkušenost s POS, gastrem, retailem, fintech produktem, dashboardy nebo design systemy je výhodou. Pokud tě láká také front-end, jsme tomu otevření.

Co ti za to nabídneme

  • spolupráci na HPP;

  • 26 dní dovolené a sick days;

  • Benefit Plus Cafeteria s měsíčním kreditem 2 000 Kč;

  • flexibilitu a možnost občasné práce z domova;

  • MacBook a další vybavení potřebné k práci;

  • palivo v podobě čerstvého ovoce, snacků a kvalitní kávy v naší karlínské kanceláři;

  • nově vytvořenou roli s velkým prostorem pro vlastní iniciativu a rozhodování;

  • přímý vliv na UX/UI celého produktu a možnost vidět dopad své práce u reálných zákazníků;

  • plnohodnotný onboarding do produktu a podporu při poznávání domény.

Proč může tahle role dávat smysl právě tobě

  • Nechceš být pouze vykonavatelem hotových designových zadání, ale chceš ovlivňovat, co a proč se bude v produktu stavět.

  • Baví tě kombinace samostatné práce, user research, prototypování a spolupráce s engineeringem.

  • Chceš pracovat na produktu, který lidé používají v reálném a náročném provozu.

  • Hledáš prostředí, kde můžeš využít dosavadní zkušenosti a zároveň si vybudovat silný ownership nad celou produktovou oblastí.

  • Vyhovuje ti autonomie, ale zároveň víš, že s ní jde ruku v ruce odpovědnost za kvalitu výsledku.

Jak probíhá výběrové řízení

  1. Pošli nám CV společně s portfoliem. Zajímá nás, na čem jsi pracoval/a.

  2. Proběhne krátký call s HR (online).

  3. Následovat bude interview se Zuzkou, naší Product Managerkou, kde si řeknete více o roli, produktu a způsobu spolupráce (osobně u nás v kanceláři).

  4. Dáme ti krátké praktické case study zadání s rozumným časem na přípravu.

  5. Ve finálním kole case study společně projdete se Zuzkou a designovým expertem z Teya (online).

Zní to jako role pro tebe? Pošli nám CV a portfolio. Rádi se s tebou spojíme, představíme ti detail role i fungování týmu a pobavíme se o tom, jak by mohla vypadat naše spolupráce.

Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers. It's the digital assistant for everyone drowning in their inbox, helping thousands of professionals reclaim hours they didn't even know they could get back.

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional contract Copywriter to join our London Marketing team.

As a company trusted by hundreds of thousands to draft their emails, we know how much language matters. So when our writing shows up in the world, our words need to be on point!

What You’ll Do

  • Write and edit compelling copy across platforms and channels (email, landing pages, product launches)

  • Maintain and evolve Fyxer's tone of voice across platforms, ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency, optimizing for engagement, clarity and impact

  • Collaborate with designers to bring ideas to life and drive acquisition, retention and engagement of high quality customers

  • Optimise copy using insights from user behaviour, engagement data, and A/B tests.

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research to inform messaging

  • Bring fresh, diverse perspectives to a high-performing team to further drive innovation and raise the bar

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5+ years of experience writing high-converting marketing copy (eg. emails, landing pages)

  • Excellent editorial judgment and mastery of tone, clarity, and CTAs. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

  • Digital-first mindset with a clear understanding of multi-platform storytelling and performance metrics

  • Hands-on with creative tools and comfortable using AI to enhance ideation, testing, and optimisation

  • Familiarity with localisation and scaling messages globally. Bonus if you've written for US audiences.

  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional partners and adapting quickly to feedback

  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and confident navigating ambiguity.

  • Entrepreneurial and highly driven — thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership

  • Passion for tech, start-ups, AI and cultural storytelling

What We Value

We hire small numbers of exceptional people who want ownership and autonomy. As a founding marketer, you’ll be expected to work with urgency and intensity, but you’ll have responsibility and see your work have a direct impact.

Folks that thrive at Fyxer

  • You want to build and have impact from the ground up.

  • You want to have unreasonable ownership of your own world

  • You work hard, with intensity everyday & move incredibly quickly

  • You always challenge the systems you’re in to be better

Our culture is intentional. It stems from the fact we're in the race of our lives to reshape one of the largest AI opportunities that exist; email. There is only first or last.
This requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact.

Bilgewater Group is a Chicago-based diversified services company founded in 2003. We operate across two core divisions: food service and care.

Our food service division manages a network of quick-service and counter-service locations across the greater Chicagoland area, serving thousands of customers every day at high-traffic venues, including commercial districts, transit hubs, and retail centers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Accounts Payable Clerk to support the processing and maintenance of vendor invoices and payment records. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with financial information and routine accounting tasks in a remote environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Process and enter vendor invoices into accounting systems

  • Review invoices for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate documentation

  • Maintain accurate accounts payable records

  • Assist with payment processing and account reconciliations

  • Research and resolve routine invoice or payment discrepancies

  • Communicate with vendors and internal teams regarding invoices and payments

  • Maintain organized financial documentation and records

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Previous experience in accounts payable, accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or a similar role

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Comfortable working with numbers, invoices, and financial records

  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

  • Good organization and follow-up skills

  • Ability to handle confidential financial information professionally

  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment

  • Reliable internet connection and workspace

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with accounting or accounts payable software

  • Familiarity with invoice processing and payment reconciliation

  • Experience working with vendor accounts

  • Background in food service, retail, hospitality, or other multi-location businesses

COMPENSATION

$20–$27 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

HIRING PROCESS

Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

Compensation Range: £140K - £180K

raw.description:
GoHighLevel Admin / Operations Specialist

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time | Paid in USD$6.00 – $9.00 USD/hour (approx. ₱64,000 – ₱96,000/month full-time; varies with exchange rate) Includes one week of paid advanced training and certification

A client's automation breaks at 2am and no leads are getting routed. Can you find the failure point, fix it, and make sure it never happens again? Do you think in triggers, conditions, and edge cases — not just clicks? If you're the person other people come to when the system stops working, keep reading.

We're hiring a GoHighLevel Admin / Operations Specialist on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll be the person who builds, maintains, and troubleshoots the GoHighLevel infrastructure that our clients' businesses run on — pipelines, workflows, automations, integrations, and reporting.

This is an operations role, not a marketing role. Your job is to make the machine run correctly, every day, for every client. When it works, nobody notices. That's the goal.


Your First Week: Paid Certification Training

Every specialist we place starts with one full week (Monday–Friday) of advanced, paid GoHighLevel training, ending in a certification exam.

You'll be trained on our standards for workflow architecture, snapshot deployment, integrations, and troubleshooting — then tested on them. Passing the certification is required to move into the full-time role. We invest in this because we hold our specialists to a higher standard than a typical GHL admin, and we'd rather train you properly than hand you a login and hope for the best.

If you already hold a GoHighLevel certification or have deep platform experience, tell us — it factors into where you land in the pay range.


What You'll Do

Build & Automate

  • Build and maintain advanced GoHighLevel workflows, triggers, and automations across multiple client sub-accounts

  • Set up and manage pipelines, opportunity stages, custom fields, custom values, and tags

  • Build and deploy snapshots, funnels, forms, surveys, and calendars

  • Configure integrations and connections (webhooks, Zapier/Make, third-party tools, tracking and conversion events)

Operate & Troubleshoot

  • Monitor automations daily and catch failures before the client does

  • Diagnose broken workflows, missed triggers, routing errors, and data issues — then document the fix

  • Manage A2P 10DLC registration, domain and email setup, phone number provisioning, and deliverability basics

  • Maintain data hygiene: duplicates, tagging standards, contact records, and reporting accuracy

Systems & Documentation

  • Write and maintain SOPs so every build is repeatable, not dependent on memory

  • Standardize account structure so any team member can pick up an account and understand it

  • Build dashboards and reporting views that give the team and clients clear visibility

  • Onboard new client accounts from a blank sub-account to fully operational

Collaboration

  • Work alongside media buyers, copywriters, and video editors — you're the operational backbone that connects their work to the client's CRM

  • Translate what the team needs into a system that delivers it

  • Flag issues early and bring solutions, not just problems

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience administering GoHighLevel (or a comparable CRM/automation platform such as HubSpot, Keap, or ActiveCampaign, with proven GHL ability)

  • Genuine workflow-level thinking: you can map a multi-step automation with branching conditions, wait steps, and failure paths — and explain why you built it that way

  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and the patience to trace a problem to its actual root cause

  • Comfort managing multiple client sub-accounts without dropping details

  • Working knowledge of integrations: webhooks, APIs, Zapier or Make

  • Clear written English — much of this role is documentation and async communication

  • Organized, methodical, and proactive — you notice what's broken before you're told

  • Reliable home office setup with stable, high-speed internet

  • Availability to work Monday–Friday with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours (9am–5pm PT). The mandatory training week is scheduled during U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Existing GoHighLevel certification

  • Agency-side experience managing GHL for multiple clients

  • Experience with home services, construction, remodeling, or local lead generation

  • Basic HTML/CSS or custom code snippets in funnels

  • Experience with A2P 10DLC, email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), or deliverability troubleshooting

  • Experience writing SOPs or training other admins

When you apply, include the word BLUEPRINT in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field. This is how we know you read the full post.


What's Included

  • $6.00 – $9.00 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. ₱64,000 – ₱96,000/month full-time) — placement in the range depends on experience, prior certification, and demonstrated skill

  • One week of paid advanced GoHighLevel training and certification, provided by us

  • After 90 days: performance bonuses tied to account health and client retention kick in

  • After 90 days: HMO coverage on your terms — choose the HMO plan that fits you (and your family), and we cover it through a monthly healthcare benefit. You pick the provider; we pay for it.

  • Fully remote, full-time position

  • Clear growth path into a Senior Operations Specialist role as the team scales

  • Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based team in the home service industry

How to Apply

Complete the application below. You'll be asked to walk us through one advanced workflow or automation you built: what problem it solved, how you structured the triggers and conditions, what edge cases you accounted for, and what broke along the way.

Be specific — this is the single most important part of your application, and vague answers will not advance.

We read every qualified application personally. No fees are charged at any stage of hiring, ever.

This position is placed through RevStone, a managed staffing company supporting U.S.-based businesses. RevStone handles your onboarding, payroll, HR, and benefits — so you can focus on the work.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

You'll own customer onboarding, the journey that turns a signed merchant into an active member of Teya.

You'll be the operator who takes a problem like "first-pass approvals are stuck at 70%" or "merchants keep dropping off at the app-login step" and ships the fix. You'll own the funnel end to end, drive the metrics that matter (first-pass approval rate, activation, time to activate), and partner across Sales, Risk, Engineering and Design to make onboarding fast, simple and reliable across our markets.

Your Team

You'll join the Sales Platform team in Product, which owns the systems behind how Teya acquires and onboards merchants: customer acquisition, onboarding, the sales CRM, pricing, and the dialler. The team serves Teya's sales channels across Europe (field sales, inside sales, Independent Sales Consultants, resellers, and self-serve), and onboarding sits on the critical path for our unified sales platform.

We move quickly and use modern tools to do it. AI is part of how the team works day to day, with Glean and Claude flowing into our workflows and internal skills and automations that let a small team ship at the pace of a much bigger one. You'll use these from day one, and you'll help us build new ones.

Your Role

On a regular day, you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding journey within the Sales Platform, from offer acceptance through to an activated, transacting member, as the directly responsible individual.

  • Drive first-pass approval rate by stripping out document friction and rework, and cutting the manual escalation load that currently props the flow up.

  • Own the roadmap and the data, finding where the funnel leaks, building the business case, prioritising, and reporting on what moved.

  • Use AI as a core part of your workflow, building and using reusable skills and automations to find drop-off, draft requirements, and move faster across the job.

Your Story

Years of experience matter less than what you've shipped. That said, most people ready for this role have roughly 3–5 years in product, ideally on an onboarding, activation or other conversion-sensitive flow.

  • You’ve built funnel dashboards in product analytics tools like Amplitude, defining event taxonomy and posing specific questions to be answered with data.

  • You've owned a funnel and moved a metric, and you can talk through what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently.

  • You're comfortable in the data. You can pull your own numbers (SQL or a self-serve tool) and turn them into where-to-focus decisions.

  • You can work across Risk, Engineering, Design and Sales without hand-holding, and you're at home with ambiguity and a lot of stakeholders.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or another regulated environment (KYC, identity, compliance) is the strongest signal, but not a hard requirement.

  • You're genuinely capable and curious about AI tooling. You've used Claude, ChatGPT or similar in your work, and you're excited to build agentic workflows that raise the quality and speed of what you ship.

  • You like simple over clever, you can strip a messy requirement back to first principles, and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect.

  • You're commercially literate. You can connect a lift in activation to revenue, and you know why it matters.

  • You're happy working onsite from our London or Porto office.

What makes this role different

  • It's B2B to SMB. You're building for small business owners, where every step you remove from onboarding is a real business getting paid sooner.

  • It's multi-market. UK, Iceland, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, with more expansion this year.

  • The stack is modern and powered by AI. Glean, Claude, and other AI tools flow into our workflows, unencumbered by legacy systems. You'll be armed with the tools and training to work at the cutting edge of what's possible.

The Perks

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, including gym access, 1-1 therapy, meditation, and digital fitness and nutrition apps

  • Work from our offices in London (House of Teya, next to Blackfriars Bridge) or Porto

  • Private Health and Life Insurance

  • Pension Scheme

  • 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Bank Holidays)

  • Opportunities to travel to our different offices across Europe

  • Regular merchant experiences at our headquarters

  • Healthy office snacks and drinks

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Remote Video Editor – Short-Form & Ad Creative

Remote | Argentina-Based | Full-Time Contractor | Paid in USD $5.50 – $8.50 USD/hour (approx. $950 – $1,475 USD/month full-time), paid weekly

Editor de video remoto (contrato full-time, pago en dólares) para una agencia de marketing en Estados Unidos.

Can you take raw footage and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad? Do you know why a viewer drops off at second 3 — and how to re-cut the hook so they don't? If editing is your craft and volume doesn't scare you, keep reading.

We're hiring a Video Editor on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll produce the video creative that powers real ad campaigns — working alongside a team of media buyers and copywriters whose campaigns live or die on the quality of your edits. When your video converts, everyone sees it in the numbers.

Argentina runs just a few hours ahead of the U.S. West Coast, so you'll work a normal daytime schedule with solid overlap with the team — same-day feedback, live creative reviews, no overnight shifts.

This is a production role with real output expectations: a minimum of 30 edited pieces of content per week. If you're fast, consistent, and take pride in clean work at volume, you'll thrive here.


What You'll Do

Editing & Production

  • Edit a minimum of 30 pieces of content per week — primarily short-form vertical video (ads, social clips, talking-head content, before/after project footage)

  • Cut raw client footage into polished, caption-ready edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and clean audio

  • Produce multiple variations of winning ads (new hooks, new CTAs, new openers) for A/B testing

  • Format deliverables correctly for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube placements

Collaboration

  • Work directly with media buyers to understand which creatives are performing and iterate on winners

  • Turn copywriters' scripts and hooks into finished video

  • Manage your queue through the team's project management system and hit deadlines without chasing

Organization & Quality

  • Maintain organized project files, brand assets, and templates for each client

  • Apply client branding consistently (logos, colors, fonts, end cards)

  • Self-review every edit before delivery — clean captions, no dead frames, correct aspect ratios

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience

  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut — fast enough in your tool of choice to hit 6 finished edits per day

  • A portfolio of short-form edits: ads, reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

  • Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and retention — you edit for the viewer who's about to scroll away

  • Experience creating captions/subtitles and editing for sound-off viewing

  • Professional working English (B2+) — briefs, feedback, and captions are in English; the team communicates in English daily

  • Organized, deadline-driven, and consistent — volume work requires systems, not heroics

  • Reliable home office setup with an editing-capable computer and stable, high-speed internet

  • Availability for a consistent Monday–Friday, full-time schedule (Argentina time) with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience using AI tools in your workflow (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Midjourney, HeyGen, or similar) — we love editors who use AI to go faster without losing quality

  • After Effects / motion graphics skills

  • Experience editing direct-response ad creative with measurable results

  • Experience editing English-language content for a U.S. audience

  • Experience with home services, construction, or local business content

  • Thumbnail or static creative design skills (Canva, Photoshop)

When you apply, include the word TIMELINE in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field. This is how we know you read the full post.


What's Included

  • $5.50 – $8.50 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. $950 – $1,475 USD/month full-time) — placement in the band depends on speed, skill level, and portfolio, with a formal review at 90 days

  • Performance bonuses tied to creative performance and output consistency

  • Monthly healthcare benefit after 90 days — a fixed USD stipend you can put toward a prepaga (OSDE, Swiss Medical, Galeno, etc.) or private coverage of your choice

  • Fully remote, full-time independent contractor position (you invoice monthly under your own monotributo/responsable inscripto status; no local employer of record)

  • Daytime hours — no night shifts

  • Growth path into a Senior Editor / Creative Lead role as the team scales

  • Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based marketing team in the home service industry


How to Apply

Complete the application below. You'll be asked to share a link to 3–5 of your best short-form edits and briefly describe one of them: what the goal was, and the editing choices you made to hit it. Applications without a portfolio link will not advance.

We read every qualified application personally. No fees are charged at any stage of hiring, ever.

This position is placed through RevStone, a managed staffing company supporting U.S.-based businesses. RevStone handles your onboarding, contracting, payments, and benefits — so you can focus on the work.

raw.excerpt: Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back.
raw.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we’ve spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we’re now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We’re at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We’re growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you’re energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help build the product marketing function at Alternative Payments.

As we expand beyond accounts receivable into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics and broader money movement, we need someone who can define who we’re building for, shape how we communicate our value and bring Product, Sales and Marketing together around a clear go-to-market strategy.

You’ll own the foundational product marketing work across our products and verticals—from ICPs, personas and buyer journeys to positioning, product launches and competitive intelligence. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who understands what strong product marketing looks like, is comfortable creating the motions that do not yet exist here and can turn customer and commercial insight into a story the market understands.

You’ll be joining a growing team at an important stage in our evolution, with significant visibility and the opportunity to shape how product marketing operates at Alternative Payments.

This hybrid role is available to candidates who are eligible to work in Canada. You'll be required to spend 3 days a week (Mon - Wed) in our centrally located downtown office (Queen W + Spadina).

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve our ICPs, buyer personas and buyer journeys across our products and priority verticals.

  • Develop clear, differentiated positioning and messaging grounded in customer needs, market evidence and the problems our products solve.

  • Partner closely with Product to understand the roadmap, influence go-to-market priorities and determine how and when new capabilities should be introduced to the market.

  • Own the product launch roadmap and go-to-market strategy for new products and major releases, coordinating across Product, Sales and Marketing from planning through execution.

  • Build and maintain our competitive intelligence program, including competitor positioning, pricing, product direction, key differentiators and defensible reasons to believe.

  • Analyze sales calls, pipeline performance, win/loss data, customer feedback and market research to identify why we win, why we lose and which messages resonate most strongly.

  • Conduct customer, prospect and Sales interviews and supplement internal insight with third-party research, user testing or market studies where needed.

  • Translate research into practical resources that help our GTM teams succeed, including messaging frameworks, sales enablement, objection handling and launch narratives.

  • Shape the story behind product-led campaigns and launch moments, including briefing content and developing the narrative for webinars, presentations and other market-facing initiatives.

  • Lead working sessions and build alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing and senior leadership, confidently recommending a direction when perspectives differ.

  • Establish the processes, workplans and measures of success needed to demonstrate the impact of product marketing over time.

  • Use AI and emerging tools to accelerate research, synthesize customer and sales insights and improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of positioning, messaging, buyer research and go-to-market strategy.

  • Experience independently leading product launches from early planning through market execution and adoption.

  • A strong understanding of product marketing fundamentals and the ability to build effective product marketing programs without relying on an established playbook or large supporting team.

  • Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, including experience with customer interviews, sales-call analysis, win/loss data, segmentation and competitive intelligence.

  • A track record of turning customer and market insight into differentiated positioning and messaging that Sales, Marketing and Product teams can put into practice.

  • Evidence that your work has influenced commercial outcomes such as product adoption, win rates, cross-sell, upsell or entry into a new market.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate alignment and constructively challenge assumptions.

  • The ability to move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution—from analyzing pipeline data to writing a launch narrative or briefing an executive.

  • Curiosity and a “detective” mindset: you enjoy getting close to customers and sellers, asking the right questions and finding the evidence needed to make a strong recommendation.

  • Comfort working through ambiguity, setting priorities and creating structure in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

  • AI literacy and an interest in using new tools to improve research and analysis; advanced technical or automation experience is not required.

  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into a clear and compelling market story.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in MSP, FinTech, payments, startup, or scale-up environments.

  • Familiarity with Jobs to be Done, Bowtie and PLG frameworks

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

    • The total compensation range for this role is $120K–$140K base, plus a 10% variable, for ~$130K–$155K OTE, and equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interview experience, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

iSpeedToLead is looking for a senior, hands-on acquisition leader to grow our Cash Offer brand and attract US homeowners who want to sell their property. You will own paid acquisition as one connected system — channels, budgets, messaging, creatives, landing pages and measurement. The goal is profitable growth in qualified seller leads, not cheaper clicks.

What you’ll own

  • Personally launch, manage and scale Google and Meta; develop TikTok; evaluate X and ChatGPT Ads where you can make a credible business case.

  • Allocate budget across channels, markets and audiences based on lead quality and commercial outcomes.

  • Turn seller insights into offers, creative briefs and landing-page tests together with our creative and development partners.

  • Connect campaign data to CRM and downstream outcomes (qualified leads, accepted and published leads, sales, refunds, realized revenue) and keep improving attribution.

  • Build a clear testing and reporting rhythm, and drive solutions independently.

What we’re looking for

  1. Proven hands-on ownership of both Google and Meta, including multi-channel budget decisions — not agency oversight.

  2. Successful US lead-generation experience. Motivated-seller and homeowner lead generation is especially relevant; home services, mortgage, insurance or lead marketplaces are also welcome.

  3. Evidence of improving lead quality and business economics beyond platform CPL and ROAS.

  4. Experience improving creative, landing pages and conversion flows with designers and developers, validated through tracking and CRM data.

  5. Fast learning and independent execution, comfortable with AI and automation, and aware of platform policy and privacy constraints.

  6. Clear professional English and genuine end-to-end ownership.

TikTok experience is a strong advantage.

How success is measured

More qualified, commercially valuable seller leads at a sustainable acquisition cost, with positive contribution after acquisition costs and downstream quality and refund effects. We look at the combined result across channels, not a single platform metric.

Your first 30 days

  • Establish a performance baseline and agree targets.

  • Prioritize and ship campaign, creative and funnel improvements.

  • Show which channel and market combinations deserve investment, with an evidence-backed scaling plan.

How to start the conversation

This is a hands-on lead role, not a strategy-only position. Please send your CV or LinkedIn profile plus 1–2 relevant cases: your personal role, the channels, spend and timeframe, the lead-quality and commercial results, and one decision that improved the outcome (anonymized cases are welcome). Also share your availability and compensation expectations.
