Why you should join us:

Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

The opportunity is massive — car insurance alone is a $300B market in the U.S. We spent the last few years building our supply (we work with 100+ insurance carriers) and our technical infrastructure (60% of policies today are sold automatically without human intervention, 90% of inbound customer inquiries are resolved via AI and automation). The next chapter is about accelerating our growth — going from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

The technical challenge:

Our insurance marketplace is our core product today, and our ability to automate the end-to-end shopping experience is our core differentiator. The AI & Automation team owns the most critical part of that – how we automate the entire insurance quoting experience for our customers and orchestrate complex, multi-step transactions with external insurance provider systems to finalize policy purchases.

Before off-the-shelf AI agents existed, we built our own proprietary infrastructure to scale automated insurance purchases and customer support. Today, 60% of insurance policies are sold automatically without human intervention, and 78% of inbound customer inquiries are resolved via AI and automation, with 83% reporting a positive experience.

Our current system is working but our use cases are rapidly growing as our business expands beyond car insurance and available AI models are also evolving. We need someone to lead the charge in building our “next generation” AI system, including building new automations for things like document validation (drivers’ licenses, proof of insurance, etc), voicebot expansion into stateful, phone-based interactions, and enable our bots to have direct external system navigation to resolve complex issues more quickly and accurately than human agents.

Note: You may see different job ads for this role at different job levels. We are only hiring one person. Our priority is finding the right person, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

What you’ll own:

  • Our AI agents and automation system, which has two components:

    • Agentic/conversational front end — chatbot, voicebot, computer-use agents; shape what the prompt engineering team builds next and keep the architecture sound as it scales.

    • Backend workflow automation — build new automations for things like document validation (ex. licenses, proof of insurance), record disputes, transaction orchestration with external carrier systems.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technology (voicebot, computer use agents, and beyond), make the call on what we invest in next, build and ship to production.

  • Partner with OpenAI to evaluate and deploy next-generation voice models and workflow automation.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years owning product strategy and execution for a technical product, ideally at an early-stage startup, where you worked hands-on enough with engineering to make technical tradeoff calls.

  • You've made a call between two valid technical approaches based on business impact, not just technical elegance, and can reason through why.

  • You've tinkered with a new model within days of its release, and you can explain why one architecture or approach is superior to another.

  • Experience putting LLM-based systems into production, including the unglamorous parts: evals, regressions, latency, cost, and failure-handling.

Our tech stack: TypeScript (Nest.js, React), GraphQL, AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda), LLM models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini)

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Job Description

Pay: $100–$150/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This role is designed for experienced ML engineers and researchers who understand the systems beneath high-level APIs. Candidates should have meaningful practical experience with multiple tools from the modern ML stack and be able to explain what they personally built, optimized, or operated.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
  2. Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.
  3. Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.
  4. Work with tensor operations, automatic differentiation, model architectures, tokenization, batching, and generation.
  5. Optimize training or inference for latency, throughput, memory usage, and hardware utilization.
  6. Diagnose numerical instability, incorrect tensor behavior, memory bottlenecks, distributed-system failures, and performance regressions.
  7. Compare model implementations and determine whether results are correct and reproducible.
  8. Review AI-generated code and technical solutions for correctness, efficiency, and engineering quality.
  9. Design objective tests, benchmarks, and verification criteria.
  10. Clearly document technical decisions, trade-offs, and limitations.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
  2. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.
  3. Practical proficiency with Python.
  4. Meaningful experience with at least two relevant ML frameworks, libraries, or inference tools.
  5. Strong understanding of model training, evaluation, numerical computation, or inference.
  6. Ability to debug ML systems beyond surface-level API usage.
  7. Ability to explain implementation decisions, performance trade-offs, and failure modes clearly.
  8. Experience building reproducible technical workflows.

Relevant tools may include:

  1. PyTorch
  2. JAX
  3. NumPy and SciPy
  4. SGLang
  5. vLLM
  6. llama.cpp
  7. Hugging Face Transformers
  8. Hugging Face Tokenizers

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

  • Edit a minimum of 30 pieces of content per week — primarily short-form vertical video (ads, social clips, talking-head content, before/after project footage)

  • Cut raw client footage into polished, caption-ready edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and clean audio

  • Produce multiple variations of winning ads (new hooks, new CTAs, new openers) for A/B testing

  • Format deliverables correctly for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube placements

Collaboration

  • Work directly with media buyers to understand which creatives are performing and iterate on winners

  • Turn copywriters' scripts and hooks into finished video

  • Manage your queue through the team's project management system and hit deadlines without chasing

Organization & Quality

  • Maintain organized project files, brand assets, and templates for each client

  • Apply client branding consistently (logos, colors, fonts, end cards)

  • Self-review every edit before delivery — clean captions, no dead frames, correct aspect ratios

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience

  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut — fast enough in your tool of choice to hit 6 finished edits per day

  • A portfolio of short-form edits: ads, reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

  • Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and retention — you edit for the viewer who's about to scroll away

  • Experience creating captions/subtitles and editing for sound-off viewing

  • Organized, deadline-driven, and consistent — volume work requires systems, not heroics

  • Reliable home office setup with an editing-capable computer and stable, high-speed internet

  • Availability for a consistent Monday–Friday full-time schedule with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours for team communication (the rest of your day is flexible)

Nice to Have

  • Experience using AI tools in your workflow (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Midjourney, HeyGen, or similar) — we love editors who use AI to go faster without losing quality

  • After Effects / motion graphics skills

  • Experience editing direct-response ad creative with measurable results

  • Experience with home services, construction, or local business content

  • Thumbnail or static creative design skills (Canva, Photoshop)

When you apply, include the word FRAMEWORK in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field. This is how we know you read the full post.


What's Included

  • $4.50 – $7.50 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. ₱48,000 – ₱80,000/month full-time) — placement in the band depends on speed, skill level, and portfolio, with a formal review at 90 days

  • Performance bonuses tied to creative performance and output consistency

  • HMO coverage on your terms — after 90 days, choose the HMO plan that fits you (and your family), and we cover it through a monthly healthcare benefit. You pick the provider; we pay for it.

  • Fully remote, full-time position

  • Growth path into a Senior Editor / Creative Lead role as the team scales

  • Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based marketing team in the home service industry

How to Apply

Complete the application below. You'll be asked to share a link to 3–5 of your best short-form edits and briefly describe one of them: what the goal was, and the editing choices you made to hit it. Applications without a portfolio link will not advance.

We read every qualified application personally. No fees are charged at any stage of hiring, ever.

This position is placed through RevStone, a managed staffing company supporting U.S.-based businesses. RevStone handles your onboarding, payroll, HR, and benefits — so you can focus on the work.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

Small businesses are the backbone of our communities — yet they remain underserved by traditional banks and legacy payment providers. As a Principal Backend Engineer, you will play a defining role in changing that.

Your mission is to design and build the resilient, scalable fintech infrastructure that underpins our most critical business initiatives. This isn’t about owning a single service — it’s about owning outcomes. You will drive the technical success of the platforms that power payments, merchant onboarding, transaction processing, and operational workflows across Europe.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering and business strategy, shaping systems that must be secure, compliant, highly available, and capable of scaling with rapid growth. The decisions you make will directly influence how quickly we can launch new products, enter new markets, and serve thousands of merchants.

This role goes beyond technical leadership. You will define and evolve the architectural foundations that multiple teams depend on, bringing clarity to ambiguity and ensuring our most important initiatives succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive the architecture behind our most critical platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and unlock new capabilities

  • Design and evolve high-scale, cloud-native systems powering payments and merchant experiences

  • Lead the development of resilient, secure, and compliant services for high-volume transaction processing

  • Shape and drive adoption of modern backend practices (Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3, Kotlin, clean architecture)

  • Architect event-driven systems (Kafka) that enable scalable, decoupled domains across teams

  • Define and enforce standards for API-first development (REST/gRPC) and domain-driven design (DDD)

  • Set the bar for availability, performance, fault tolerance, and observability across critical systems

  • Partner deeply with Product, Data, and leadership to translate business priorities into scalable technical strategy

  • Lead cross-organisational initiatives that are essential to company growth and market expansion

  • Influence engineering direction through hands-on contribution, design leadership, and mentorship

  • Bring structure to ambiguity across technical, regulatory, and operational domains

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience building and operating distributed, production-grade backend systems

  • Proven track record operating at Senior Staff or Principal level, driving architecture across multiple teams or domains

  • Deep expertise in Java (17+), Spring Boot, and modern backend engineering practices

  • Strong experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous systems

  • Experience building systems for high throughput, low latency, and reliability, ideally in fintech or transaction-heavy environments

  • Strong grounding in system design, data structures, and performance trade-offs

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes in production environments

  • Proven ability to implement observability, resilience patterns, and CI/CD best practices

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and align stakeholders

  • A track record of mentoring senior engineers and leading through ambiguity

The Perks

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long it suits both you and your team;

  • Health Insurance;

  • Meal Allowance;

  • 25 days of Annual leave (+ Bank holidays);

  • Public Transportation Card;

  • Frequent team events & activities in the office and outside;

  • Office snacks every day;

  • Friendly, comfortable and informal office environment.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

About Keyrock

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have entities in the UK, France, Liechtenstein, the US, Switzerland, Brazil, Seychelles and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full-service capital markets and asset & wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

Job description

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary package, with various benefits

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

THE ROLE

The role: This is a 4-month maternity cover contract. If we have an open spot after the maternity cover and you loved your time at Foxelli, we'd be able to welcome you long term.

What we're looking for:

We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager (4-month maternity cover) who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role.

This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in.

You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people actually want to click, read, and buy from.

If you love:

  • mixing strategy with execution

  • testing ideas

  • improving funnels

  • and making pretty things convert

…and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person 👀

🚀 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes).

  • Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities.

  • Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps.

  • Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns.

  • Manage marketing projects from idea → launch → improvement.

✍️ Creative & Content Magic

You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work.

raw.title: Sr. Global Alliance Director, Channel and GSI
raw.excerpt: As Director Global Alliance Leader at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building the channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room.
raw.description:
As Director Global Alliance Leader at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just signing reseller agreements; you are building the channel that lets the world’s AI infrastructure resellers sell tenant isolation without us in the room. Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. Your first targets are the partners where our path to the money is right now: WWT and Computacenter, then SHI, CDW, and the national and regional VARs that actually sell AI infrastructure. You can pull in GSIs, ISVs, and distributors where they accelerate a reseller deal; the global system integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, EY) stay with the VP. (Internally titled Director, Alliances, Channel & VARs)

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. There is no channel to inherit and no team underneath you. Success is measured in partner-sourced bookings, transacting partners, and registered deals that close. Not in logos signed.

As Sr. Global Alliance Director, Channel and GSI, your role will include:

  • Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction (agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, first close) and retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

  • Transaction mechanics: You will own the reseller commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. You will run deal registration and Partner of Record (regional PoR, active-engagement standards, renewal rights, and conflict resolution that holds up when two partners claim the same account), and build distribution where it scales the motion while keeping the quoting and order path clean enough that partners do not route around it.

  • Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers with deal registration the field trusts, and give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

  • Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect reseller opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a GSI, ISV, or distributor accelerates a reseller deal, you bring them in.

  • Enablement, marketing, and MDF: You will own sales and technical certification for your partners and hold the tier requirements. You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached (field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, customer stories) and approve MDF against pipeline outcomes with proof of performance enforced. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

  • Owning the channel number: MEDDPICC on every partner-attached opportunity. Weekly pipeline inspection. Partner attribution queryable from day one; pipeline we cannot query is pipeline we do not have. QBRs on a fixed cadence with a fixed agenda: bookings against plan, named-account inspection, certification status, marketing execution, renewal health, forward-quarter plan. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs; you report your KPIs without being asked: transacting partners, sourced and attached pipeline and bookings, registration volume and win rate, certified resources, MDF return.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Channel leadership with a number behind it: 8+ years in channel, reseller, or partner sales in infrastructure software, AI infrastructure, or cloud, with a demonstrable record of building a reseller channel from early stage to producing revenue: partners recruited, activated, and transacting, with the bookings to show for it. You can name the partners you activated and the revenue they produced.

  • Deep VAR ecosystem experience: Direct, current relationships across national and regional VARs and infrastructure resellers (WWT, Computacenter, SHI, CDW, Insight, Presidio, AHEAD, ePlus, Connection, Softcat, Mark III, Pacific Teck), with the depth to open a conversation in your first week. You know which ones actually sell AI infrastructure and which ones talk about it, how a VAR makes money, how their sellers get paid, where services attach sits, and what has to be true for a rep to lead with your product instead of the one they already know. You know the distributors and when to use them.

  • Channel mechanics: Working command of tier and discount structures, deal registration, Partner of Record, renewal rights, distribution, and MDF governance. You can defend a discount structure, resolve a channel conflict without losing either partner, and tell a VAR no.

  • AI infrastructure fluency: Working understanding of Kubernetes, cloud-native architecture, and GPU and AI infrastructure. Enough depth to earn credibility with a partner SE and enough range to translate it into margin and services opportunity for their leadership.

  • Influence without authority: Proven ability to mobilize sales, marketing, legal, and enablement teams on both sides of a partnership without direct organizational control. You write the program terms; you do not forward the ask.

  • Operating rigor and builder’s instinct: Disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), forecast hygiene, and reporting discipline, paired with comfort in an ambiguous, high-velocity environment with no inherited program and no inherited team. You compress timelines rather than manage them. Running an established channel is a different job; we are hiring for the build. A builder, not a caretaker.

Bonus points for:

  • NVIDIA partner ecosystem experience: NCP and reseller-facing programs.

  • Distribution experience with Arrow, TD SYNNEX, Ingram Micro, or regional equivalents.

  • Public sector, sovereign, or regulated-industry channel experience.

  • Open-source commercial model experience: how a channel sells against a free tier.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

Culture & Values

raw.description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

A pozícióról

Területi értékesítési koordinátorként a régiódhoz tartozó független értékesítők (ISC-k) mindennapi munkáját, szakmai fejlődését és eredményességét támogatod. Olyan kollégát keresünk, aki saját értékesítési tapasztalatára építve gyakorlati segítséget tud adni az ISC-k számára, és hozzájárul ahhoz, hogy hatékonyabban, magabiztosabban és egyre önállóbban dolgozzanak.

Ez nem klasszikus vezetői pozíció: az ISC-k önállóan dolgozó értékesítők, ezért a szerepkör alapja a szakmai hitelesség, a partneri együttműködés és a mindennapi támogatás. Szorosan együtt dolgozol velük, különösen a csatlakozásukat követő első 90 napban, és segíted őket az értékesítési munkában, az adminisztrációban és az új folyamatok elsajátításában.

Főbb feladatok

  • A régiódhoz tartozó, jutalékos rendszerben dolgozó független értékesítők (ISC-k) támogatása, motiválása és teljesítményük nyomon követése.

  • Az új ISC-k támogatása különösen az első 90 napban: rendszeres kapcsolattartás, a célok egyeztetése, visszajelzés és gyakorlati segítség.

  • Rendszeres személyes látogatások az értékesítők területén, közös ügyféllátogatások és segítségnyújtás a kereskedőkkel folytatott megbeszéléseken.

  • Heti és havi teljesítményértékelések szervezése, az eredmények, az aktivitás és a folyamatban lévő értékesítési lehetőségek közös áttekintése.

  • Az ISC-khez kapcsolódó adminisztratív feladatok támogatása, különösen a KYC-folyamatok, a szükséges dokumentumok és a folyamatok státuszának nyomon követése.

  • Ügyfélszerzést támogató kezdeményezések megtervezése és megvalósítása a régió növekedésének elősegítésére.

  • Az új termékfunkciók, folyamatok, értékesítési eszközök és kommunikációs üzenetek bemutatása, valamint az ISC-k rendszeres képzése ezek használatára.

  • Az ISC-k kérdéseinek és visszajelzéseinek összegyűjtése, a problémák megoldásának támogatása és szükség esetén továbbítása a megfelelő belső csapatok felé.

  • A teljesítmény- vagy minőségi problémák korai felismerése, az okok feltárása és fejlesztési javaslatok megfogalmazása.

  • Rendszeres személyes találkozók és tudásmegosztó alkalmak szervezése az ISC-k számára.

Amit várunk tőled

  • Bizonyított tapasztalat B2B, lehetőleg terepi értékesítésben; előnyt jelent a fizetési megoldások, a fintech vagy a szoftveres szolgáltatások területén szerzett tapasztalat.

  • Tapasztalat értékesítők, partnerek vagy önállóan dolgozó értékesítési hálózatok támogatásában és teljesítményük fejlesztésében.

  • Magabiztosan használod és értelmezed a teljesítménymutatókat, az értékesítési folyamat adatait és a kapcsolódó jelentéseket.

  • Kiemelkedő szervezőkészség, precizitás és adminisztratív fegyelem; több párhuzamos feladatot is megbízhatóan kezelsz.

  • Egyenes, támogató és empatikus kommunikáció; képes vagy világos elvárásokat megfogalmazni és őszinte visszajelzést adni partneri hangnemben.

  • Gyakorlati és megoldásközpontú gondolkodás: felismered az elakadásokat, és képes vagy az ISC-k számára konkrét, használható segítséget adni.

  • B kategóriás jogosítvány és vállalás arra, hogy munkaidőd legalább 50%-át személyes találkozókkal és terepmunkával töltöd.

Mit jelent ebben a szerepben jól teljesíteni?

Akkor végzed jól a munkád, ha a régiód független értékesítői megfelelő szakmai és adminisztratív támogatást kapnak, rendszeresen fejlődnek, és egyre önállóbban érnek el eredményeket. Értékesítési tapasztalatodra építve felismered az elakadásokat, gyakorlati megoldásokat adsz, és megbízható kapcsolattartóként segíted az ISC-k mindennapi munkáját.

Amit kínálunk:

  • Versenyképes fizetés

  • Csapatépítő rendezvények és tevékenységek az irodában és azon kívül

  • Barátságos, kényelmes és informális irodai környezet Buda szívében

  • AYCM Sporting Pass, amely országszerte több száz sportlétesítményhez biztosít hozzáférést

  • SZÉP kártya

  • Utazási támogatás

  • Magánegészségügyi biztosítás

  • Évi három extra szabadnap

  • 5 terápiás vagy coaching alkalom évente

  • Minden nap irodai snackek, gyümölcsök és üdítők

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre, kérjük, hogy jelezd felénk. Elkötelezettek vagyunk amellett, hogy a jelentkezési folyamat mindenki számára elérhető legyen.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

We're looking for a TikTok Ads Expert to drive paid social growth across Valerie's portfolio of ecommerce brands. You'll own TikTok performance end-to-end — from campaign strategy and execution to creative testing, optimisation, and performance analysis — ensuring TikTok consistently contributes to profitable customer acquisition and revenue growth.

You'll work closely with Creative, Analytics, Paid Media, AI, and Brand teams to identify winning creative concepts, audiences, and campaign strategies through continuous experimentation. Success in this role isn't measured by how many campaigns are launched or reports are shared; it's measured by how effectively TikTok scales profitably, how quickly winning creative is identified, and how effectively performance insights are turned into business growth.

Senior Google Ads Manager (Ecommerce)

Whiskey Library | Full time | Remote, worldwide

Whiskey Library is looking for a curious, commercially minded marketer with deep Google Ads expertise. You will develop the messaging, write the copy and run the experiments that grow our Bourbon Mystery Box subscription and online bottle shop.

You will have room to form a point of view, put it into practice and improve it through testing. Working directly with our CMO, creative team and landing-page designer, you will take ideas from customer insight through to execution and the next iteration.

About Whiskey Library

We help people discover great craft whiskey through our Bourbon Mystery Box, a monthly subscription of full-size bottles chosen around their tastes, and our online bottle shop.

We buy single barrels and small blends directly from craft distilleries and independent bottlers, with both names on the label. We also carry bottles from their core ranges. That gives you a mix of familiar producers and distinctive selections to market.

We are a small, global, fully remote team. We value ownership, speed and high-quality output over process or hierarchy.

What you will own

  • Study customer reviews, search queries, objections and competing offers to develop ideas about what will persuade someone to buy.

  • Develop messaging that fits our brand, write and refine ad copy, and bring specific creative and landing-page concepts to the team.

  • Own a prioritised testing plan. Define a hypothesis and success measure, run focused A/B tests, assess the evidence and use what you learn to shape the next experiment.

  • Execute Google Ads strategy across Search, Shopping, Performance Max and other suitable formats, including campaign structure, bidding and budget management.

  • Keep conversion tracking, Merchant Center and product feeds working reliably, coordinating fixes with the team.

  • Assess acquisition cost, order value, gross profit and customer lifetime value, with clear separation between branded and non-branded activity, subscriptions and retail.

  • Share findings with the wider marketing team, turn their insights into new tests, and follow through independently on agreed work.


You will make routine account decisions independently. Budget increases, offer changes and major shifts in strategy are agreed with our CMO, particularly when they affect other channels.

What you bring

  • Strong marketing judgment and writing ability. You can connect customer insight to persuasive copy and explain why a message fits the brand.

  • Curiosity demonstrated through your work: questions you investigated, assumptions you challenged and ideas you changed when the evidence surprised you.

  • A repeatable testing method. You can walk us through a hypothesis, the test you ran, what the results did or did not establish, and what you tried next.

  • Proven ecommerce Google Ads execution, with practical knowledge of Merchant Center, product feeds, conversion tracking, Google Analytics and attribution.

  • Commercial judgment about profitable customer growth, with examples of results you personally helped produce.

  • Strong written English, independent follow-through and a collaborative approach to sharing ideas, giving briefs and responding to feedback.


Experience with subscription businesses, alcohol ecommerce or scaling accounts into six figures of monthly spend is helpful.

Working with us

This is a full-time role focused on Whiskey Library. You should be able to work primarily during US Eastern business hours initially. We can agree on more flexibility as the working relationship develops.

You will have direct access to our CMO, support from our creative and design teams, and quarterly performance bonuses.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and one brief example of a marketing experiment you personally developed and executed for an e-commerce Google account. Explain the customer insight, the messaging or copy you tested, the result, and what you did next. Anonymized examples are welcome.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid account diagnosis and propose a focused messaging test.

raw.description:
As Sr. Global Alliance Director at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just shipping integrations; you are deciding which stack the world’s AI factories get built out of. Every AI factory ships as a stack: servers from an OEM, a validated design, a scheduler, an observability layer, a data platform, a management plane. The tenant isolation layer is the part nobody has solved. Your job is to make sure that layer is already in the OEM’s reference architecture, already in the price book, and already integrated with the ISVs sitting next to us before the customer ever runs a bake-off. Being in the design is worth more than winning the deal, because you win every deal that design produces.

This is a founding, zero-to-one role on a first-year partner program. There is no partner channel to inherit and no team underneath you. You own the number, the agreements behind it, and the product that ships inside someone else’s box.

As Sr. Global Alliance Director your role will include:

  • Owning the OEM alliance strategy: You will own the server and systems vendors building validated AI infrastructure designs end to end: strategy, executive alignment, program agreements, and business reviews. You will design and stand up the OEM commercial model (embedded SKUs, unit economics, tiered pricing for bundled and embedded distribution, royalty and per-node constructs, and a standard OEM order template that lets legal review once and the field move fast), then negotiate and close the orders. You will monitor each OEM’s AI factory roadmap to spot the design cycle before it closes, not after.

  • Building the ISV portfolio: You will scope, prioritize, and drive integrations with the storage, network, scheduler, observability, security, data, MLOps, and inference vendors whose customers overlap with ours, running it as a portfolio with explicit thresholds, not a queue of requests. You will land vCluster inside ISV and SaaS platforms as the tenant isolation layer, whether the ISV embeds it, resells it, or co-sells it. You will kill integrations that will not produce, and say so early. An ISV embed that does not change the partner’s own roadmap is a logo, not a route.

  • Building the sell-with motion: A shipped integration with no joint motion behind it is a cost, not an asset. You will design repeatable co-sell plays on top of every integration that earns one (account mapping, joint solution briefs, field-to-field engagement, deal registration the partner’s sellers actually use), then connect the resulting opportunities to vCluster’s regional sellers, channel partners, and the NVIDIA alliance to close. You take bundles to market through the partner’s own sales motion, not around it.

  • Driving technical alignment on both sides: You will represent partner technology requirements inside vCluster Product and Engineering with evidence attached (which accounts, what revenue, what happens if we do nothing), through one front door: licensing, telemetry, air-gapped operation, support boundaries, and lifecycle. You will write the integration specifications and acceptance criteria yourself. Integration work fails on unclear criteria far more often than on technical difficulty, and that clarity is yours to own.

  • Building the technology alliance program: You will design and launch the program itself: tiers, technical certification requirements, joint solution briefs, marketplace and private offer paths, and a self-serve path so a small ISV can integrate without you in the loop. The program has to scale past the partners you personally manage.

  • Owning the partnership number: You will report partner-influenced pipeline, integration and certification milestones, joint bookings contribution, and field activation to vCluster leadership, with MEDDPICC on every joint opportunity and weekly pipeline inspection. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs; you show up to the weekly inspection with your own numbers, your own forecast, and your own plan to close the gap. Data over opinions. Process over heroics.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Alliance leadership at scale: 10+ years in technology alliances, OEM or ISV partnerships, partner sales, or ecosystem leadership in enterprise infrastructure software, with a proven track record of integrations and design wins that produced significant, measurable partner-influenced revenue. You can name the deals.

  • Deep OEM and ISV ecosystem experience: You have gotten a product embedded in someone else’s stack (a validated design, a reference architecture, an OEM catalog, a marketplace listing, a shipped ISV integration) and you know how to navigate a massive, matrixed organization from engineering leads and solutions architecture to GTM leadership. Direct, current relationships across hardware OEMs (Dell, HPE, Supermicro, Lenovo, Cisco), storage vendors (VAST Data, WEKA, DDN, NetApp, Pure), and infrastructure ISVs. You can name the people, not just the logos.

  • AI infrastructure fluency: Working understanding of Kubernetes, cloud-native platforms, and AI/ML infrastructure, plus the GPU stack these designs are built around (DGX and NVL-class systems, networking and DPUs, schedulers, inference serving). Enough to look at an ISV’s product and tell whether the integration is thirty days of work or a quarter, and to earn credibility with architects while translating it into ROI for executives.

  • Commercial construction: You can build a price book, model a royalty, and structure support and warranty flow-down that engineering and legal will both sign. You can hold your position against people who negotiate embedding agreements for a living.

  • Influence without authority: Demonstrated ability to mobilize cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Marketing, regional sales) on both sides of an alliance, without direct organizational control. You write the acceptance criteria; you do not forward the request.

  • Operating rigor and builder’s instinct: Disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), forecasting hygiene, and reporting discipline, paired with comfort in an ambiguous, high-velocity environment with no inherited program and no inherited team. You compress timelines rather than manage them. Taking over an established partner business and growing it is a different job; we are hiring for the build. A builder, not a caretaker.

Bonus points for:

  • Prior OEM design work: History of getting software named in a server OEM’s AI infrastructure reference or validated design.

  • NVIDIA partner ecosystem experience: NCP, ISV certification, or reference architecture programs.

  • Open-source ecosystem credibility: CNCF standing or maintainer and contributor experience in an adjacent project, and a feel for the boundary between an open project and an embedded commercial product.

  • Adjacent stack and marketplace fluency: Slurm, Ray, Run:ai, or inference serving stacks in production; cloud marketplace private offers and committed-spend drawdown across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $225K - $280K

Remote | Colombia-Based | Full-Time Contractor | Paid in USD $6.50 – $9.50 USD/hour (approx. $1,125 – $1,650 USD/month full-time), paid weekly

Editor de video remoto (contrato full-time, pago en dólares) para una agencia de marketing en Estados Unidos.

Can you take raw footage and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad? Do you know why a viewer drops off at second 3 — and how to re-cut the hook so they don't? If editing is your craft and volume doesn't scare you, keep reading.

We're hiring a Video Editor on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll produce the video creative that powers real ad campaigns — working alongside a team of media buyers and copywriters whose campaigns live or die on the quality of your edits. When your video converts, everyone sees it in the numbers.

Because Colombia sits on U.S. Central time, you'll work a normal daytime schedule with full overlap with the team — same-day feedback, live creative reviews, no overnight shifts.

This is a production role with real output expectations: a minimum of 30 edited pieces of content per week. If you're fast, consistent, and take pride in clean work at volume, you'll thrive here.


What You'll Do

Editing & Production

  • Edit a minimum of 30 pieces of content per week — primarily short-form vertical video (ads, social clips, talking-head content, before/after project footage)

  • Cut raw client footage into polished, caption-ready edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and clean audio

  • Produce multiple variations of winning ads (new hooks, new CTAs, new openers) for A/B testing

  • Format deliverables correctly for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube placements

Collaboration

  • Work directly with media buyers to understand which creatives are performing and iterate on winners

  • Turn copywriters' scripts and hooks into finished video

  • Manage your queue through the team's project management system and hit deadlines without chasing

Organization & Quality

  • Maintain organized project files, brand assets, and templates for each client

  • Apply client branding consistently (logos, colors, fonts, end cards)

  • Self-review every edit before delivery — clean captions, no dead frames, correct aspect ratios

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience

  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut — fast enough in your tool of choice to hit 6 finished edits per day

  • A portfolio of short-form edits: ads, reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

  • Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and retention — you edit for the viewer who's about to scroll away

  • Experience creating captions/subtitles and editing for sound-off viewing

  • Professional working English (B2+) — briefs, feedback, and captions are in English; the team communicates in English daily

  • Organized, deadline-driven, and consistent — volume work requires systems, not heroics

  • Reliable home office setup with an editing-capable computer and stable, high-speed internet

  • Availability for a consistent Monday–Friday, full-time daytime schedule (Colombia time), overlapping U.S. Pacific business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience using AI tools in your workflow (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Midjourney, HeyGen, or similar) — we love editors who use AI to go faster without losing quality

  • After Effects / motion graphics skills

  • Experience editing direct-response ad creative with measurable results

  • Experience editing English-language content for a U.S. audience

  • Experience with home services, construction, or local business content

  • Thumbnail or static creative design skills (Canva, Photoshop)

When you apply, include the word STORYBOARD in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field. This is how we know you read the full post.


What's Included

  • $6.50 – $9.50 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. $1,125 – $1,650 USD/month full-time) — placement in the band depends on speed, skill level, and portfolio, with a formal review at 90 days

  • Performance bonuses tied to creative performance and output consistency

  • Monthly healthcare benefit after 90 days — a fixed USD stipend you can put toward your EPS/prepaid medicine plan or private coverage of your choice

  • Fully remote, full-time independent contractor position

  • Daytime hours aligned with U.S. Central time — no night shifts

  • Growth path into a Senior Editor / Creative Lead role as the team scales

  • Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based marketing team in the home service industry

How to Apply

Complete the application below. You'll be asked to share a link to 3–5 of your best short-form edits and briefly describe one of them: what the goal was, and the editing choices you made to hit it. Applications without a portfolio link will not advance.

We read every qualified application personally. No fees are charged at any stage of hiring, ever.

This position is placed through RevStone, a managed staffing company supporting U.S.-based businesses. RevStone handles your onboarding, contracting, payments, and benefits — so you can focus on the work.

At Gradient Labs, we're building the AI customer operations platform for financial services.

Founded in 2023, we now work with some of the biggest names in banking and fintech. Our platform runs specialist agents, purpose-built for financial services, to eliminate manual work across customer support and back-office operations. Together, they give product and operations teams the visibility and control to trust every outcome.

We're a team of builders from companies like Monzo, Wise, Revolut and Google. If you're excited to tackle some of the hardest problems in AI and help shape the future of customer operations, we'd love to hear from you.

🎯 How you’ll make an impact

This is a role where you’ll own opportunities and outcomes all the way from conversations with customers to testing hypotheses, running experiments, and proposing and delivering optimisations in our agent.

You will:

  • Be at the frontline of our product - talk to customers and align directly on what success looks like and how it’s measured. You’ll use raw, real-world data to form clear, actionable insights.

  • Directly optimise the performance of our agent, tuning and improving it against those metrics for every customer we onboard.

  • Own the optimisation flow end to end - you’ll use data to translate opportunities into tangible improvements in our agent, and close the loop by delivering and demonstrating that value.

  • Get obsessive with the data: understand the data at the lowest level, then leverage this to form and test robust hypotheses about the bigger picture.

  • Work across multiple teams and functions to bring shared understanding of where the highest impact opportunities are and how we deliver on them. Own your work end to end and scope your own initiatives - you'll be given real trust and independence, not a ticket queue.

  • Turn ad hoc analyses and findings into powerful, scalable tooling for teammates and customers to self-serve.

💡 What you’ll bring

  • Significant data science experience at a lead/staff level; building robust data pipelines is second nature, you’re fluent in SQL and Python, and have a strong understanding of statistical methods.

  • A background working in a startup or a fast-moving tech environment, close to the product or customer side of the business.

  • A knack for solving data puzzles and going from SQL queries to clear conclusions and next steps.

You’ll tackle challenging and new problems, work with some of the most exciting brands across different industries, and be surrounded by a passionate, smart team that’s driven to build something groundbreaking.

raw.description:
Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

Who we’re looking for

Based in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for an experienced Front End Engineer who knows code, and enjoys creating engaging experiences that people love to use.

At what3words, we're proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You'll be exposed to technologies such as ReactJS, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS Lambdas, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Athena, BigQuery, Java, Scala, C++, and Swift.

This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative, ambitious and Agile team, at one of the most exciting times in this company's life.

Requirements:
This role will focus primarily on the development of our map site, account management system, and other websites to support and showcase what3words’ offerings. You will also work closely with our product and UX teams, receiving and inputting on designs and feasibility checks, and bringing fresh ideas to make what3words a better solution. You will have good experience of building sleek user interfaces on top of RESTful web APIs, using React, JavaScript, CSS. You will be able to work independently, self-motivate, collaborate well with others and keep calm under pressure.

What we expect:

  • Strong experience with ES6, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS.

  • Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English.

  • A passion for software engineering and continuous learning.

  • Solid track record of building responsive sites for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Bonus points for:

  • Knowledge of Next.js, Google Maps or Leaflet, GIS systems, AWS, Kubernetes, or similar systems.

  • Experience of Agile working environments.

The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office. While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work with your main office timezone).

Equality, diversity and inclusion at what3words

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our hiring processes and company culture.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits to all permanent employees of what3words:

  • Competitive salary

  • Flexible working

  • 6 week remote working (work from anywhere) policy

  • 25 days holiday: plus the option to buy more!

  • Share options

  • Private health insurance

  • Wellbeing Days

  • Generous parental leave policies

  • Family friendly policies

  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

  • Lunch & learn sessions

  • Team social budget

raw.description:
We’re seeking a skilled Forward Deployed Full-Stack Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.

As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field. You’re part engineer, part technical advisor, and wholly accountable for making the mission succeed. The position requires an active U.S. Secret clearance.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Build out application components and pages.

  • Implement historical and real-time data feeds using WebGPU.

  • Design and develop data models using Postgres and Apache Iceberg.

  • Modify real-time data pipelines using MQTT and Redpanda.

  • Modify offline data pipelines using Dagster for batch processing.

  • Modify and integrate machine learning models or other algorithms into the application.

  • Improve local development and CI/CD using modern tooling and GitHub Actions.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Full-Stack Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Active Secret Clearance.

  • Expertise in TypeScript.

  • Expertise in CSS, such as TailwindCSS.

  • Experience with React and frontend frameworks such as Next.js.

  • Familiar with state management such as React Context.

  • Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs.

  • Proficiency with SQL/PostgreSQL.

  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of Python.

Full-Time · Remote (Lahore) · $1,500–$2,200 USD/monthHours: U.S. business hours (Pacific/Central), Monday–Friday


About RevStone

RevStone is a U.S.-based managed staffing company. We place trained, World-Wide-based Operators into growing American businesses. We are not a VA marketplace. We are your employer on this side — we handle payroll, benefits, and support, and we back you with SOPs, training, and a real team lead who has your back.


About the Client

You'll be placed full-time with a fast-growing U.S. digital marketing agency that builds and manages websites for a portfolio of small and mid-sized business clients across multiple industries. They need one person who owns SEO across all of those client sites — not a task-taker, but the agency's in-house SEO expert.


The Role

This is a "Swiss Army knife" SEO role. You won't be working on one website. You'll be working across a portfolio of client sites built on different platforms — WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, and others — and you need to be comfortable jumping between them without hand-holding.

One day you're fixing crawl errors on a Webflow site. The next you're building out a local SEO plan for a service business, writing content briefs for an e-commerce client, and presenting a monthly report to the agency's account manager. If that sounds like fun instead of chaos, keep reading.


What You'll Own

  • Technical SEO across all client sites: audits, Core Web Vitals, crawl and indexing issues, redirects, site architecture, schema markup

  • Platform-specific implementation on WordPress (Yoast/RankMath, page builders) and Webflow (CMS collections, custom code embeds, SEO settings), plus Shopify and other builders as needed

  • Keyword research and search intent mapping for clients in very different industries

  • On-page SEO: titles, metas, headers, internal linking, content optimization

  • Local SEO for service-based clients: Google Business Profile, citations, service-area and location pages

  • Content strategy: briefs and content calendars that writers can execute

  • Link building and digital PR outreach

  • New website launches: SEO migration checklists so clients don't lose rankings when a site is rebuilt

  • Reporting: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush — rankings, traffic, conversions, clearly explained

  • Being the SEO voice inside the agency: telling account managers what each client needs next and why

You're a Fit If You Have

  • 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts at once

  • Proven results you can show with screenshots (GSC, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar)

  • Real, hands-on experience with both WordPress and Webflow — you've built or optimized live sites on each

  • Strong technical SEO fundamentals: you can read a crawl report, diagnose why something isn't indexing, and fix it yourself

  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and the ability to implement schema and technical fixes without waiting on a developer

  • Fluency with Google Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs or Semrush

  • Excellent written and spoken English — you'll communicate directly with the U.S. team and occasionally clients

  • The ability to work U.S. hours consistently with reliable internet and backup power

  • Strong organization: you can juggle 10+ client accounts and know what's due on each without being reminded

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, or GoHighLevel websites

  • E-commerce SEO experience (product pages, collection pages, faceted navigation)

  • Familiarity with AI search / generative engine optimization (AI Overviews, ChatGPT search visibility)

  • Experience running or supporting Google Ads / Local Service Ads

  • Basic understanding of CRO and landing page optimization

What You Get

  • $1,500–$2,200 USD/month, full-time, long-term, paid in USD (and converted to your local currency)

  • HMO coverage after 90 days — you pick the plan and provider that's right for you and your family, and we cover it

  • Performance bonuses after 90 days

  • Paid onboarding and SOPs so you start with clarity, not guesswork

  • A dedicated RevStone team lead who supports you throughout the placement

  • Stable work with a growing U.S. agency — not project-to-project freelancing

How We Hire

  1. Apply below (5 minutes)

  2. Short SEO knowledge screen

  3. Paid technical audit test on a real client site (one WordPress, one Webflow)

  4. Interview with RevStone, then a meet-and-greet with the agency

  5. Offer

In Your Application, Please Include

  • 2–3 examples of SEO results you personally drove, with screenshots

  • Links to at least one WordPress site and one Webflow site you've worked on

  • The SEO tools you use daily

  • Your available start date

We read every application. If you're the real deal, we'll know fast.
